note: Every invariant below was measured at the current head during I16. `proof` names the I16 artifact or test that produced the measurement; older checkpoints appear only as supporting ancestry.

invariants.invariant: Arbitrary provider source bytes are stored and retrieved byte-for-byte, including non-UTF8 and embedded NUL.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_G4_01_EXACT_EVIDENCE.json (8 awkward-source roundtrips + ZSTD transparency)
invariants.failure_consequence: Evidence becomes unfalsifiable: a re-fetch could not be distinguished from the original.

invariants.invariant: Content identity is the source SHA-256; it never depends on provider, sensor, date or wrapper encoding.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_G4_03_IMMUTABILITY.json (replay returns the same identity; divergent content is a separate identity)
invariants.failure_consequence: The same payload fetched twice would create two truths and break deduplication.

invariants.invariant: No crash window yields a half-valid final object; publication is no-replace and durable before success is returned.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_CRASH_MATRIX.json (6 blob windows + 5 pointer windows, 0 half-valid finals)
invariants.failure_consequence: A torn object could be read as complete evidence after a crash.

invariants.invariant: A committed T0A object cannot be overwritten through any public storage API.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_G4_03_IMMUTABILITY.json + test_hostile_final_name_is_refused_not_followed + test_hardlink_mutation_is_detected_not_silently_accepted
invariants.failure_consequence: Accepted history could be silently rewritten by a later write or an attacker.

invariants.invariant: A partition pointer only becomes visible after the manifest it names is durable.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_CRASH_MATRIX.json manifest rows: P1-P3 leave no visible pointer; P4-P5 leave exactly one version
invariants.failure_consequence: A reader could observe a pointer to evidence that does not exist.

invariants.invariant: The resume checkpoint advances only after the durable manifest commit, and never on a torn pointer.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_G4_12_BLOC3_HANDOFF.json (3 advances, each gated on a manifest readable from disk)
invariants.failure_consequence: A restart could skip a page whose evidence was never written.

invariants.invariant: Same source key with different bytes creates an explicit numbered revision; both versions remain readable.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_REVISION_MATRIX.json (2 segments for one key; old and new bytes both verified after restart)
invariants.failure_consequence: A provider correction would silently erase the earlier observation.

invariants.invariant: Revising a non-first member of an envelope group leaves earlier members intact, and identical content refetch creates no revision.
invariants.proof: test_non_first_member_mutation_creates_a_revision + test_same_content_refetch_does_not_create_a_revision
invariants.failure_consequence: Multi-page groups would lose or duplicate members on retry.

invariants.invariant: Every T0B projection resolves completely to T0A blob and acquisition evidence before a manifest may reference it.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_G4_06_LINEAGE.json; a projection-less manifest fails closed with ProjectionChainBroken
invariants.failure_consequence: Derived evidence could exist with no verifiable source.

invariants.invariant: No acquisition, confirmed-empty, known-gap, failure and history-unavailable are distinct typed states; none becomes a numeric zero.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_G4_07_MISSINGNESS.json
invariants.failure_consequence: An unobserved interval would be indistinguishable from a real price of zero.

invariants.invariant: Optional high-volume writes pause before critical P0 sensor evidence, and no priority crosses the hard free-space floor.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_QUOTA_SIMULATION.json (CONSTRAINED: P2 DEFERT, P3 PAUSE; CRITICAL: P0 WARN, P1-P3 BLOCK; floor blocks P0)
invariants.failure_consequence: Disk exhaustion would destroy the highest-value evidence first.

invariants.invariant: Quota and retention policy never auto-deletes raw T0A evidence.
invariants.authority: storage.quota is side-effect-free; deletion authority lives only in storage.retention
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_QUOTA_SIMULATION.json t0a_auto_delete_count = 0 across all four pressure states
invariants.failure_consequence: Pressure response could destroy the raw evidence it is meant to protect.

invariants.invariant: DuckDB is a derived discovery index; deleting it loses no durable truth, and a corrupt durable source fails the rebuild loudly.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_DUCKDB_REBUILD.json (delete + rebuild reached identity and row parity; corrupt source raised DuckDBCatalogError)
invariants.failure_consequence: A disposable index would become an unrecoverable single source of truth.

invariants.invariant: PostgreSQL carries metadata and state only; it is an operational mirror and dropping it loses no T0 evidence.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_G4_10_OPERATIONAL_METADATA.json (scalar SQL types only; no bytea/blob; no secret column)
invariants.failure_consequence: Postgres would become a bulk raw store and a competing authority.
invariants.limitation: No PostgreSQL DSN was available in this environment, so no live DB execution was performed or claimed; the gate rests on the current-head schema and runtime contract test plus accepted I11 live evidence.

invariants.invariant: A verified evidence pack restores into an empty root with hash, identity, query, revision and lineage parity, and is promoted atomically.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_RESTORE_TEST.json
invariants.failure_consequence: A restore would silently produce different evidence than the source.

invariants.invariant: No credential or secret-bearing value is persisted in evidence metadata, and secrets are refused rather than stored.
invariants.proof: test_i15_hardening.py (48 passed) after the I16 fixture DSN was rebuilt at runtime
invariants.failure_consequence: Persisted evidence would leak credentials into backups and exports.

invariants.invariant: Resolved local paths are never canonical identity; the storage root is movable and object keys are portable and backend-neutral.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_RESTORE_TEST.json (pack relocated to an unrelated root before restore) and the G4-13 path-independence proof
invariants.failure_consequence: Evidence identity would be bound to one workstation's filesystem layout.

invariants.invariant: Destination and source are re-verified at commit time; a preplaced or tampered final name is refused, not followed.
invariants.authority: storage.atomic no-replace publish + LocalBlobStore._verify_existing + I15 TOCTOU hardening
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_G4_03_IMMUTABILITY.json (ExistingBlobIntegrityConflict 'NOT overwritten'; hardlink mutation detected)
invariants.failure_consequence: An attacker could substitute bytes between verification and publication.

invariants.invariant: Export, verify, restore and pack operations are bounded and fail with typed resource-limit errors rather than exhausting the host.
invariants.proof: Accepted I15 resource-bounds matrix (supporting) and the current-head restore path exercised under VerifyLimits
invariants.failure_consequence: A malformed or hostile pack could exhaust memory or disk during restore.

invariants.invariant: Adapter output persists through the public handoff and the job chain advances only on durable evidence, with no external job-state manipulation.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_G4_12_BLOC3_HANDOFF.json
invariants.failure_consequence: Bloc 3 would believe it had delivered evidence that Bloc 4 never committed.

invariants.invariant: The handoff exposes sufficient SOURCE, TIMESTAMP, UNIT and LINEAGE evidence for a Bloc 5 PIT normalization pass without filesystem or path assumptions.
invariants.proof: BLOC_04_I16_BLOC4_READINESS.json
invariants.failure_consequence: Bloc 5 cannot derive or verify a provider-native unit from the public handoff contract, so PIT normalization would have to guess a unit or read provider-specific files. SOURCE, TIME and LINEAGE are satisfied; only UNIT is not.
invariants.measured_detail: RawNormalizationBatch has 20 fields and no unit field; crypto_sensor_fabric.storage.__all__ has 194 names and no unit-named export; no public enum member is UNIT_UNVERIFIED; ProjectionSchemaDefinition.to_descriptor() exposes exactly name/type/nullable per provider-native field. The test-only Bloc 5 consumer, restricted to public storage imports, reports unit native_unit and unit_state as NOT_REACHABLE.
